<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Frieza's Soldiers''' are the foot soldiers of Frieza's army, which occupies [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. Three soldier models share identical drops and spawn conditions; the first model also fires ki blasts. A soldier standing in the Namekian Ruins is the scout of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Frieza's Soldiers spawn in the Ajissa Plains and Sacred Land biomes of Namek (spawn weight 2 and groups of 1 for each model). They are '''wild enemies''': they spawn under open sky, day or night, away from torches and other light. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Bestiary#How wild enemies spawn|how wild enemies spawn]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
Natural soldiers fight on the '''Novice''' AI tier. Their health and damage above are their base values.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Each model drops:
* 1–2 '''Iron Ingot''' (+0–1 Looting)
* '''Blaster Cannon''': rare (about a 5% chance, slightly increased by Looting)
</translate>

<translate>
== Raids and story == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Ruins|Namekian Ruins]], a Namekian settlement razed by Frieza's army, have a Frieza soldier in the plaza: killing it starts [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], where waves of much stronger soldiers escort Frieza's elite.

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]] you fight them in '''Landing on Namek''' (8 soldiers), '''Defend the Namekians''' (16), '''Raid Frieza's Ship''' (10) and '''Guard the Medical Machine''' (3 waves of 4).
</translate>
